label: Trade War Room: loaded contracts (front- or back-loaded, max 5 per roster) are now their own compliance check on both mobile and desktop — a trade that would push a team over the limit disables Accept and names the team and count, independent of the cap check. The lineup check is relabeled "structural lineup feasibility": it confirms enough players exist at each position, and now says plainly — in both the ok and heads-up states — that it does not account for this week's byes, injuries, Out/Doubtful designations, or kickoff locks. Both checks share the same server-computed card as the cap and roster rows already did.
